lines.rom: arati sriramayanaji ki kirati kalita lalita siya pi ki
gavata brahmadika muni narada balamika bigyana bisarada suka sanakadi sesa aru sarada barani pavanasuta kirati niki
gavata beda purana astadasa chao sastra saba gramthana ko rasa muni jana dhana samtana ko sarabasa sara amsa sammata sabahi ki
gavata samtata sambhu bhavani aru ghatasambhava muni bigyani byasa adi kabibarja bakhani kagabhusumdi garuda ke hi ki
kalimala harani bisaya rasa phiki subhaga simgara mukti jubati ki dalana roga bhava muri ami ki tata mata saba bidhi tulasi ki
